test_title: PYST 09: RRB ALP CBT I - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Nov 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to T if ‘M − N ÷ P + S × T’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷ 
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: ‘M − N ÷ P + S × T’

Means, M is brother of N, N is father of P,

P is mother of S and S is wife T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c0464c969369dfed7b1ca65b0977a614333666bfe5803f0bdf294c244bf4c72.png] 

Thus,** M is wife's mother's father's brother of T.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
